name: FiveM
description: FiveM (FXServer) roleplay server. Requires a Cfx.re license key and a server.cfg.

install.script:
set -e
mkdir -p resources cache
cat > server.cfg <<'EOF'
endpoint_add_tcp "0.0.0.0:30120"
endpoint_add_udp "0.0.0.0:30120"
sv_hostname "Porgous FiveM Server"
sv_maxclients 32
sv_licenseKey "changeme"
ensure mapmanager
ensure chat
ensure spawnmanager
ensure sessionmanager
ensure fivem
ensure hardcap
ensure rconlog
EOF
echo 'Edit server.cfg, set sv_licenseKey, then start the server.'

variables.name: Cfx.re license key
variables.description: Key from https://keymaster.fivem.net. Without it FXServer will not start.

notes: Set sv_licenseKey in server.cfg via the file manager before first start. Resources go in the resources folder.
